remarks: Welcome home to this spacious and sunlit townhouse!!! This charming rental offers 2 generous bedrooms, 1.5 baths, and a finished lower level with direct access to a one car garage. Enjoy a comfortable porch just off the large eat in kitchen. In addition to the attached garage, there is plenty of on site parking available. Perfect location for commuters and for anyone who wants to enjoy the convenience of city living. A short walk to local attractions, including the public library, schools, places of worship, restaurants, and shopping. Public transportation is just feet away. Additional features include central air and in unit laundry with new washer & dryer. Do not miss this wonderful opportunity!!!
